protocol.selection: Require ML event coverage in validation E5/E7 on both seeds and fewer aggregate ML false-positive seconds on E1, benign_telemetry and both unseen nominal regimes than the all21 q.975 validation reference. Minimize those false-positive seconds, then maximize operational-event coverage, then deterministic mode/quantile order. New operational coverage is measured separately and is not a claim of cyberattack coverage. If none qualify retain Phase A ML. No final-test tuning.
